processing: footnote-marker tags <sup foot_note=...>n</sup> removed from 'text'; 'raw' is the string as served

verses.raw: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
verses.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

verses.raw: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,<sup foot_note=256323>1</sup> then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.raw: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

verses.raw: Except Iblees;<sup foot_note=256326>1</sup> he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
verses.text: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

verses.raw: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?<sup foot_note=256327>1</sup> Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
verses.text: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
